review_description: I had Sean from Supergreen solutions explain the process of changing over to a Tesla Powerwall 3 from Sungrow inverters, and he was very knowledgeable and informative.  I had the install done within a month with be best quote provided.  The installers were amazing, they talked me through everything they would do and gave sound advice on best placement.  They were very neat and tidy and the end result was compact and very organised.  I and super happy with my Tesla Powerwall 3 and the service I was provided with, I totally recommend Supergreen solutions.
I regret going with this company, worst decision.

One of your recommended installers are Brisbane based & did not contact me. I discounted the Cairns installer because I've had problems in the past when dealing with out-of-town tradies. The third recommendation was very good & is locally based. However, I went with my friend's recommendation who was slightly cheaper & has been operating locally for a long time. Thanks for your time & effort. I've gained a lot of knowledge through your website.

We went for top quality materials from a leading conglomerate and an organisation that has vested in the future (LG panels and Teslar battery). We got over 6 quotes and the company we decided to go with were able to put together the best of what WE were after based on our research and requirements. They put forward a proposal that accommodated what we were after, and that was no more nor no less expensive as the other quotes. The service and responsiveness has been outstanding so far.
